correctness.rationale: The Reuleaux triangle curvature radius has a threefold periodic square wave, with nonzero odd 3ell Fourier modes. Inverting h+h″=rho gives support coefficients proportional [ell(1-9ell^2)]^-1, which are absolutely summable; rotating/averaging multiplies nth harmonic by cos(n delta/2). Parseval/Green area formula yields D(x)=1/pi sum_{ell odd}(1+cos(ell x))/(ell^2(9ell^2-1)), x=3delta. The exact cosine expansion sum_{odd} cos(ell x)/(9ell^2-1)=pi/36*(sqrt3*cos(x/3)-3*sin(x/3)) holds by direct cosine-coefficient integration; differentiating twice with D′(0)=0, D(pi)=0 yields claimed trigonometric area. Its derivative is (2sqrt3 cos(delta-pi/6)-3)w^2/4>0 for 0<delta<pi/3, and trigonometric reflection proves the sum conservation. The verifier additionally checks symbolic identities and finite independently sampled circle-arc support areas; not relied upon for continuum proof.
